responsibilities.name: Build
responsibilities.claim: Build the platform from the infrastructure up.
responsibilities.text: Installation, web stack, databases, DNS, HTTPS, email, and the services the LMS depends on.

responsibilities.name: Secure
responsibilities.claim: Protect the system without losing sight of how it works.
responsibilities.text: Access control, firewalling, service exposure, TLS, hardening, permissions, and recovery before risky changes.

responsibilities.name: Operate
responsibilities.claim: Keep the platform observable, maintainable, and recoverable.
responsibilities.text: Caching, backups, monitoring, automation, scheduling, troubleshooting, and operational verification.
